judge.rationale: The candidate ignored almost all specific naming and behavioral requirements in the issue, inventing `list_sessions` and `session_list` instead of the specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list`. It directly violated core requirements by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is unimplemented instead of adding and returning `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, by omitting the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag entirely, and by accepting `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` when the issue explicitly requires integers 1–200. It also touched existing lines in `src/types/messages.ts` (violating the additive-only diff requirement), logged raw database error messages (`error.message`) on failure, and skipped the required changes to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`. Finally, it left a stray `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the repository.
